_about: Release gate for research answers (commercial-readiness review R8, 2026-10-28). Engineering proposals: they need the owner's and counsel's sign-off before they are release criteria (status). A failed bar fails the run (exit 2); it is never hidden.
status: proposed — awaiting owner and counsel sign-off
gate_runs_note: Proposed 2026-10-29 (EV15): three runs of each set measured at answer temperatures 0.1 and 0.0 moved by up to 3 declines and 2 answers from run to run at either temperature, so a gate scores three runs together.
heldout_note: Frozen 2026-10-28 (h-account-said-time included). Changing the held-out set needs a new checksum here and a note in docs/echomind-legal/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md; it is never tuned against.
heldout2_note: Frozen 2026-10-28 before any change to the answer path: 15 unanswerable near-misses (14 + 1 T06) and 15 answerable look-alikes, written from the corpus alone, none in golden or heldout. Run once per version; never tuned against.
heldout3_note: Frozen 2026-10-28 before the attribution work, after held-out 2 had been seen: 15 unanswerable items (13 cross-document traps — the clause exists in another document of the matter, not the one asked about — 1 plain, 1 T06) and 14 answerable look-alikes, none in the earlier sets. Run once per version; never tuned against.
heldout4_note: Frozen 2026-10-28 before the standing/party work, after held-out 3 had been seen: 15 unanswerable items (7 party mix-ups — the fact exists for another party — 6 cross-document traps, 1 plain, 1 T06) and 13 answerable look-alikes, none in the earlier sets. Run once per version; never tuned against.
heldout5_note: Frozen 2026-10-28 before the party-action and wrong-clause work, after held-out 4 had been seen: 16 unanswerable items (6 party actions asked without a possessive, 6 clauses for another purpose near the asked term, 3 cross-document traps, 1 T06) and 12 answerable look-alikes, none in the earlier sets. Run once per version; never tuned against.
heldout6_note: Frozen 2026-10-28 before the sampling-noise and hedge work, after held-out 5 had been seen: 15 unanswerable items (14 that invite 'not stated' followed by a true but unrelated fact about the same person, clause or event — one of them another party's registration number — and 1 T06) and 17 answerable look-alikes, 6 of them worded so a hedging model may wrongly decline; none in the earlier sets. Run once per version; never tuned against.
heldout7_note: Frozen 2026-10-29 before the precision, quote and value-hedge work, after held-out 6 had been seen: 16 unanswerable items (15 where the asked words are in a document but the asked value is not — a schedule the MSA refers to, the votes on another item, a quorum rule next to 'the meeting was quorate' — one of them also a cross-document trap, and 1 T06) and 15 answerable look-alikes, 8 where other documents share the asked terms; none in the earlier sets. Run once per version (three runs pooled); never tuned against.
